notes: The shell's frame (#902): the top bar the page's `Navbar` draws and the bottom bar `BottomTabBar` draws, measured against `ShellTopBar` and `ShellTabBar` at 393. The page draws the chrome only on its primary routes - `/`, `/community`, `/account` - so it is recorded on `/`, the one every member can reach with no session. `origin` is the top bar because the two clients' windows are not the same height: the design is the bars' own boxes and the gap the frame leaves between them, not where the frame starts. There is no `capture`: the page's bars are glass over the page's content, and the account tab has the member's avatar floated over it, so a raster of the frame is a raster of the hero and of the session - the gate entry's `why` says why the frame is contract-only. Colours - the active tab's violet, the bar's tint - are not measured for the same reason: they are composited against content the app does not draw. The services sheet is a state of its own (it opens over the frame), not the frame at rest.
